faults.page says: The 2025 annual report of Museum Dr8888 says only that the house is held in a separate stichting while Museum Dr8888 runs exploitation and programming and a change of direction is being prepared with Gemeente Smallingerland. It does not say who founded the stichting, that its board is independent, or that it is private or a charity. The report is about another institution (the museum).

faults.stored: The 2025 annual report sections 2, 3 and 4 say Stichting Hendrik Chabot was founded in 1992, is a cultural ANBI, runs a supervisory board model since March 2023 and pays its employees under the museum CAO.
faults.page says: The CAO sentence on paying employees sits in section 5 (Fair Practice Code), not in sections 2, 3 or 4; section 3 does not hold the cited facts.
faults.fix: The 2025 annual report sections 2 and 4 say Stichting Hendrik Chabot was founded in 1992, is a cultural ANBI and runs a supervisory board model since March 2023, and section 5 says employees are paid under the museum CAO.
